title: Pleroma costs and checks
description: Measured costs of Pleroma operations, a superposed kernel against item-by-item building, dense and sparse pages, and the repair and corruption checks.
claim: A superposed kernel applies in 0.17 to 0.44 ms on a 10,464-cell store whether it holds 1 or 10,368 elements, and the repair and corruption checks recovered or detected every case tried.

headline.label: one kernel pass on a 10,464-cell store, from 1 to 10,368 elements
lost harmonics rebuilt for each of 1 to 5 with 5 reserved keys
single corrupted cells detected in either copy

method.workload: Each row is one operation on one store shape, timed or checked on the shape named in the row. Checks are exhaustive or random within the stated count.
method.verification: Every timed operation is compared with a brute-force or naive implementation, and each check counts the cases that matched.
method.statistic: Per-call times, warmed up, with the range across repeated runs where one is shown.
method.machine: One laptop CPU (Intel i9-11950H), release build, with other work running.
method.memory: Page and kernel figures use the default field.
